answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel framework Multi-Turn Safety Alignment (MTSA) to address the challenge of securing LLMs in multi-round interactions.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates multi-turn dialogues between a red-team model and a target model, aiming to produce adversarial prompts and defensive responses in a safety-aligned dialogue system.

answer_2.quote: We use Attack success rate (ASR) to evaluate attack effectiveness. Also we evaluated the harm of the response with the help of GPT-4o.
